# Phase 4 (GENDB) work packets

Draft split of the 475 new P4 functions of `docs/re/pre64_batch_ledger.tsv` (branch claude/project-thread-xp4r5r).
Each function goes to the first packet whose root reaches it (direct calls, from `pre64_funcs.tsv`). The roots and roles come from `docs/re/db-model-mapping.md` and `dbmap/stepdriver.md` (claude/project-thread-bz5k5e).

**Fidelity:** Ghidra can print floating-point sums with the wrong grouping (the P1 gate found this in rotate2d). Check every FP expression against the disassembly.
Step writes must set g_db.put_mesh_no, put_step, put_sim_no, put_sim_mode, put_interval and dyn_hdr, as GENDB does (p1-12 dbcore, claude/p1-12-dbcore @43c171b).

**Tests (every packet):** tier 2/3 DB byte identity against the oracle cache (masked dates): GENDB from corpus KEY files and from DBREAD steps, new DB and append to an old DB.

| Packet | Functions | Roots | Role |
|---|---:|---|---|
| p4-01 driver, frame, menu 7 | 66 | 140002800, 140002a60, 140004ca0... | menu 7 (14000a370), 1401b9940, 1401bb550, 1401bcbb0, DB header 1401bffb0, region sizes 1401c03f0, buffers, address tables, dynamic arrays 1401c5260 |
| p4-02a object counts (1401beb30) | 56 | 140130230, 140130410, 140134120... | object counts 1401beb30 (NOBJ, NUMNP, NUMEL per object) |
| p4-02b counts frame: materials, relations, groups (1401bc230) | 67 | 14001cd60, 14001cd70, 14001cd80... | 1401bc230 itself and its other counts (stepdriver.md section 5.4): 1401bdaf0, materials 1401be510 / 1401bea90, relations 1401be660, material groups 1401be700 |
| p4-03 object checks | 76 | 14001cdc0, 140163540, 140167e90... | object checks 1401b9d50, 1401bfed0 and the others in the check chain |
| p4-04 sim-control / inter-object checks | 34 | 14001cda0, 14017a130, 1401bebf0... | check chain 1401bebf0: sim control 1401becf0, inter-object 1401bff40 |
| p4-05 object arrays 3D | 77 | 140131210, 140131360, 1401317c0... | object arrays, 3D (14017b370) |
| p4-06 object 2D, sim control, materials, inter-object writers | 52 | 140131600, 1401667e0, 140166980... | object 2D (14017cb60), sim control 1401effc0, materials 14029bdf0, inter-object 1401fa4f0 |
| p4-07 step header | 47 | 140158d00, 140161100, 1401638f0... | step header 1401c5020 / 1401e2180 |

Dependencies: p4-01 calls every other packet. p4-05 and p4-06 need p4-02a/b (the counts), and p4-07 needs p4-05 and p4-06 (the per-object statistics). p4-02a and p4-02b can run in parallel.
